# Voiding (VOI)

When an issued invoice can be voided, how, and what a void leaves behind.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/void

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## Contents

- [VOI-001](#voi-001) — Void only an invoice that should never have been issued
- [VOI-002](#voi-002) — Void an issued invoice through the void operation; delete a draft
- [VOI-003](#voi-003) — A void adds a cancellation record; the original stays

## VOI-001

**Void only an invoice that should never have been issued**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: critical · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Void an invoice only when it was issued by mistake: the sale or service it describes never took place, it was a test, or it is an accidental duplicate. An invoice for an operation that did happen is never voided to fix it; it is corrected with a corrective invoice.

**Why:** A void removes the invoice's fiscal effect altogether. Using it on a real operation, even to reissue it right after, takes a real sale out of the books; the law provides the corrective invoice for that.

**Applies to:** statuses `ISSUED`, `SENT`, `PAID`, `RECTIFIED`; operations `voidCompanyInvoice`

**Decides:**

- *The invoice should never have been issued: the operation did not take place, it was a test, or it is an accidental duplicate.* → Void it. Its number stays used; if a valid invoice is still due, issue it as a new one.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), art. 11.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#a11
- AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3), 17. Forma de proceder ante errores cometidos al facturar — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/FAQs-Desarrolladores.pdf

**Incorrect:** The customer's VAT rate was wrong on an invoice for work you did deliver, so you void it and issue a new one.

**Correct:** The same invoice is corrected with a corrective invoice; a duplicate fired twice by a retry is voided.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/void

{ "reason": "Duplicate of invoice F-2026-0142, issued twice by mistake" }
```

**Related:** VOI-002, COR-001, LIF-003, NUM-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/cancel-and-fix#the-30-second-decision · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/cancel-and-fix#anulación-void

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/VOI-001.md

## VOI-002

**Void an issued invoice through the void operation; delete a draft**

`MUST` · BeeL. rule · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

An issued invoice (ISSUED, SENT, PAID or RECTIFIED) is voided only with the void operation, with a reason of 10 to 500 characters. A draft or a scheduled invoice is not voided: it is deleted, and it had no number to lose.

**Why:** The void operation is what records the cancellation and, under VeriFactu, sends it to AEAT; a status change cannot. A second void of the same invoice is refused, so a retried void is safe to treat as done.

**Applies to:** operations `voidCompanyInvoice`, `deleteCompanyInvoice`, `setCompanyInvoiceStatus`

**Error codes:** [`TRANSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/TRANSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED), [`INVOICE_ALREADY_VOIDED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/INVOICE_ALREADY_VOIDED), [`CANCELLATION_VIA_SPECIFIC_ENDPOINT`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/CANCELLATION_VIA_SPECIFIC_ENDPOINT)

**Decides:**

- Void: allowed in `ISSUED`, `SENT`, `PAID`, `RECTIFIED`; otherwise refused with `TRANSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED` (`VOIDED`: `INVOICE_ALREADY_VOIDED`)

**Incorrect:** Setting the status to VOIDED with the status operation: it answers CANCELLATION_VIA_SPECIFIC_ENDPOINT.

```http
PUT /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/status

{ "status": "VOIDED" }
```

**Correct:** Calling the void operation with the reason.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/void

{ "reason": "Invoice issued to the wrong customer" }
```

**Related:** VOI-001, VOI-003, LIF-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#voiding-and-correcting

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/VOI-002.md

## VOI-003

**A void adds a cancellation record; the original stays**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

Voiding an invoice under VeriFactu generates a cancellation record (registro de anulación) that identifies the original by its number and issue date; the original registration record is never removed. Follow the cancellation as a record of its own, with its own status.

**Why:** AEAT keeps both records, linked. Reading only the invoice's registration status after a void hides whether AEAT accepted the cancellation.

**Applies to:** statuses `VOIDED`; operations `voidCompanyInvoice`, `listCompanyInvoiceVerifactuRecords`; Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), art. 11.2.c) y d) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#a11
- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), art. 8.2.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#a8

**Incorrect:** Treating the invoice's verifactu.submission_status right after a void as the answer to the cancellation.

**Correct:** Listing the invoice's VeriFactu records and reading the VOID record's own status.

```http
GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/verifactu-records
```

**Related:** VOI-002, REC-008, LIF-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/cancel-and-fix#did-aeat-accept-the-cancellation

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/VOI-003.md
